name: F5 高周期方向过滤 · 顺势回调
notes: 方向性过滤而非开关式过滤：只在 1 日趋势向上时买超卖，向下时卖超买。假设：无差别的双向回复在单边行情里一路接刀，把方向锁死能去掉最贵的那一半交易。

signals.longEntry: rsi(close, rsiN) < os and close > sma(close, htf)
signals.longExit: rsi(close, rsiN) > 50 or close < sma(close, htf)
signals.shortEntry: rsi(close, rsiN) > 100 - os and close < sma(close, htf)
signals.shortExit: rsi(close, rsiN) < 50 or close > sma(close, htf)
